subject: Deferred PO conditioning, invoice split bands & approval flow
messages:
From: Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@brightforge.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: payments@brightforge.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: PO acceptance and invoice bands for DF-8432

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the thorough demo last week. Procurement here at BrightForge is ready to move forward but has a few requirements before they will issue a blanket PO:

- PO must reference our GL code and have line‑level SKU descriptions matched to your SOW.
- We require the option to split invoices by product band (Compute vs Support vs Integrations) and receive weekly remittance for small invoices (< $5k).
- Net terms: Finance prefers Net45 but will accept Net30 for the first 3 months if we can get a 5% volume discount schedule after $75k/month.
- Evidence: they want a signed SOW and the PO template populated as attachments to validate against our ERP.

I attached BrightForge's PO template for you to populate. Can you confirm Redwood can: (1) populate the GL and SKU lines, (2) emit separate invoices per band, and (3) accept the Net45 cadence with the proposed discount trigger?

If any of the above is a hard blocker please flag it — we want to avoid multiple iteration cycles with procurement.

Regards,
Claire Mendes
Head of Procurement, BrightForge
claire.mendes@brightforge.com

Attachment: BrightForge_PO_Template.docx (fillable PO template)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@brightforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO acceptance and invoice bands for DF-8432

Claire —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the template. Short answers up front: yes on GL and SKU mapping; yes on separate invoices per band; discount trigger is doable but we need to align on measurement and fallbacks.

Notes / clarifying questions:
- SKU mapping: we can populate line items from the SOW but need your canonical SKU IDs for the Integrations bundle to ensure ERP matching. If you can drop a reference column in the template we’ll echo it.
- Invoice cadence: weekly remittance for invoices under $5k works. For larger invoices we will default to monthly grouped statements unless you prefer continuing weekly.
- Net terms / discount: 5% post $75k/month is implementable as a reconciliation credit rather than retroactive invoice modification. We need a definition window (calendar month) and an audit set (HubSpot invoice ids + usage export) for your AP to reconcile.
- Approval: to speed procurement we can populate and return the template within 48 hours once we have the Integrations SKUs.

Looping in Ben (billing) and Karthik (sales ops) to confirm accounting and implementation steps.

Next steps: Claire — please provide the Integrations SKU list and confirm whether BrightForge prefers weekly remittance for all bands during the onboarding period (first 60 days).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf, pricing_summary.xlsx (breakdown by band)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@brightforge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO acceptance and invoice bands for DF-8432

Claire / Priya —

Quick operational confirmation from billing side:

- We can emit separate invoices per band. Implementation path: tag usage and invoice templates with band metadata (compute/support/integrations). We’ll need the mapping within the PO to preserve line semantics for your ERP.
- For Net45 vs Net30: offering Net30 for the first 90 days is fine, however the 5% volume discount will be handled as a monthly credit applied to the next invoice cycle (not a reduction on the originally issued invoice). That meets audit requirements.
- Weekly remittance: we support a weekly small‑invoice rail. Our AR team will send an invoice digest and individual PDFs to payments@brightforge.com every Friday. We need an AP remit mailbox and an EFT reference template — can you confirm the expected remittance reference field?

Priya — action items for Redwood: populate the PO template with GL+line items, create banded invoice templates, and add a reconciliation row in the pricing_summary.xlsx explaining the credit flow. I’ll prepare a short technical note for procurement describing the credit mechanics for their ERP.

Ben Carter
Manager, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@brightforge.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO acceptance and invoice bands for DF-8432

Ben / Priya —

Thanks — that flow sounds fine. A few follow ups from Procurement/Finance:

- Integrations SKUs: attaching a list (excerpt) — please use the SKU column when you populate the template. If you can echo back the PO with matching SKU values we’ll fast‑track ERP acceptance.
- AP remit reference: we use the field "PO_REF|GFID" (please include pipe delimited) so our ERP can match the line level.
- Weekly remittance: keep it for all bands during the 60‑day onboarding. After that switch Support & Integrations to monthly unless invoice volume stays > $75k/month.
- Can you put the discount as a separate credit line on the invoice rather than an external credit memo? That would save us a manual step on our end.

I’ve looped in payments@brightforge.com for the EFT template. If you can return populated PO by COB Tuesday (11/9) we’ll aim to issue the blanket PO by Thursday.

Regards,
Claire

Attachment: brightforge_integrations_skus.csv (excerpt)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Claire Mendes <claire.mendes@brightforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO acceptance and invoice bands for DF-8432

Claire —

Attached is the populated PO using your template. Highlights:
- All Integrations SKUs echoed in the PO SKU column; added Redwood internal SKU crosswalk in the comments column for clarity.
- Invoice template: we will emit banded invoices (Compute / Support / Integrations) and include a credit line for volume discounts (named "Volume Discount - DF-8432"). That credit will appear on the next billing cycle per Ben's note.
- Remittance: invoices under $5k will be included in the weekly digest to payments@brightforge.com every Friday; EFT reference field populated as PO_REF|GFID per your spec.
- Net terms: default Net45; switching to Net30 for first 90 days is recorded in the SOW amendment and will be tracked via HubSpot for automated alerts.

Next steps from our side: Ben will generate the technical note for your ERP; Karthik will push the populated PO and the billing example into HubSpot and the DocuSign link for signature. Priya will follow up once the DocuSign is sent so you can route to Procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Priya

Attachments: BrightForge_PO_Template_populated.docx, billing_erp_note.pdf
